seed_why: PUBLIC (the g5.35 pool and viewer streams); the run-time secret keys every harness-side draw
secret_why: 32 bytes of os.urandom made INSIDE `harness_oop.py run` after prctl(PR_SET_DUMPABLE, 0); only its sha256 leaves the process before the results commit (written here in the pre-run commit, which the waiting run checks before any trial)
falsifier_1: PROVED iff A* (viewer_oop.py attacker) run OUT of process is inside the one-sided binomial alpha-0.01 bound over all 200 trials AND over train (0..99) AND over held-out (100..199), AND the F1 null viewer re-run out of process is inside chance (alpha 0.05) AND the F2 salt mutant re-run out of process scores 200/200; RED (disproved) if A* beats the bound
mutant_M1: the same A* run IN process (harness_oop.InProc) scores >= 150/200, else VOID
mutant_M2: EXACT counts, else VOID: on the fixed draw 0 of the 800 decoys are a run target (any trial) and 0 are an earlier trial's target; on the old draw replayed from round 2's revealed secret, 74 of 800 decoys are an EARLIER trial's target (the C2 channel, the leaf's 74) and 144 are ANY run target
mutant_M3: `harness_oop.py m3`: a parent with dumpable LEFT at 1 and its own fresh secret (revealed in results_oop_m3.json, not pre-committed: it is a mutant, not a measurement): A* reads the secret via /proc/PPID/mem (>= 150/200 hits AND >= 150 rows on channel mem), else the /proc channel of A* is VOID
limit: same uid only (a second uid needs the owner's sudo); root or CAP_SYS_PTRACE bypasses the fence; the verdict covers exactly the same-uid reads A* tries (frame, gc, /proc/PPID environ, cmdline, fd, mem, every file under the run dir and the rv dir, its own env and argv)
